design: The design record and its data-flow diagram: data sources, training pipeline, model artefact, retrieval corpus, prompts, tools and the inference API.
stride: Each data-flow element is walked with the six STRIDE categories, with trust boundaries marked.
aiclasses: The list is extended with AI-specific attack classes from MITRE ATLAS, NIST AI 100-2 and the OWASP Top 10 lists: poisoning, evasion, extraction, prompt injection, unsafe model files.
decide: Each threat is rated on the organisation's likelihood and severity scales and mitigated, avoided, transferred or accepted.
tests: Every mitigated threat names the test that proves the mitigation: a red-team case, an eval, a pipeline check or a guardrail test.
gate: The design review is a gate: it fails while any threat above tolerance has no mitigation or no test.
register: Accepted threats become risk-register entries with a named acceptor.
blocked: A design with an untested threat above tolerance does not pass review.
